description: This source file defines data models and constants for the OpenClaw protocol, including message frames, request/response types, error handling, agent management, session management, configuration, and auxiliary structures used in the communication between clients and servers within the OpenClaw system.

classes.name: ErrorCode
classes.description: Enumeration of error codes used in the protocol for representing specific error conditions.

classes.name: ConnectParams
classes.description: Struct for establishing a connection, including protocols, client info, capabilities, permissions, and other connection parameters.

classes.name: HelloOk
classes.description: Response structure sent during handshake, including protocol version, server info, features, snapshot, auth, and policy.

classes.name: RequestFrame
classes.description: Generic request message with identifier, method, and parameters.

classes.name: ResponseFrame
classes.description: Generic response message with success flag, payload, and error info.

classes.name: EventFrame
classes.description: Event message structure for asynchronous events including event type, payload, and sequence.

classes.name: PresenceEntry
classes.description: Represents a presence information entry with details like host, ip, version, and tags.

classes.name: StateVersion
classes.description: Tracks presence and health version numbers for state synchronization.

classes.name: Snapshot
classes.description: Represents a full state snapshot including presence, health, and version info.

classes.name: ErrorShape
classes.description: Structure describing an error with code, message, details, and retry options.

classes.name: AgentEvent
classes.description: Structure for events related to agent activities, including sequence and data.

classes.name: SendParams
classes.description: Parameters for sending messages, including recipient, message content, media, channels, and idempotency key.

classes.name: PollParams
classes.description: Parameters for creating a poll in a session.

classes.name: AgentParams
classes.description: Parameters for sending a message to an agent, including delivery options and attachments.

classes.name: AgentIdentityParams
classes.description: Parameters to request or identify an agent session.

classes.name: AgentIdentityResult
classes.description: Result containing agent identification info, including name, avatar, emoji.

classes.name: AgentWaitParams
classes.description: Parameters to wait for an agent run event with timeout.

classes.name: WakeParams
classes.description: Parameters for waking up a node with mode and text.

classes.name: NodePairRequestParams
classes.description: Parameters for requesting node pairing with details like node ID, platform info, and remote IP.

classes.name: NodePairListParams
classes.description: Parameters for listing node pair requests (empty here).

classes.name: NodePairApproveParams
classes.description: Parameters for approving a node pairing request.

classes.name: NodePairRejectParams
classes.description: Parameters for rejecting a node pairing request.

classes.name: NodePairVerifyParams
classes.description: Parameters for verifying a node with node ID and token.

classes.name: NodeRenameParams
classes.description: Parameters for renaming a node.

classes.name: NodeListParams
classes.description: Parameters for listing nodes (empty here).

classes.name: NodePendingAckParams
classes.description: Parameters for acknowledging node requests.

classes.name: NodeDescribeParams
classes.description: Parameters for describing a node.

classes.name: NodeInvokeParams
classes.description: Parameters for invoking a command on a node.

classes.name: NodeInvokeResultParams
classes.description: Result data for a node command invocation, including payload or error.

classes.name: NodeEventParams
classes.description: Parameters for triggering a node event.

classes.name: NodePendingDrainParams
classes.description: Parameters for draining a node.

classes.name: NodePendingDrainResult
classes.description: Result for node drain operation.

classes.name: NodePendingEnqueueParams
classes.description: Parameters to enqueue a task on a node.

classes.name: NodePendingEnqueueResult
classes.description: Result for enqueue operation with queued items.

classes.name: NodeInvokeRequestEvent
classes.description: Event triggered to invoke a command on a node with JSON params.

classes.name: PushTestParams
classes.description: Parameters for testing push notifications.

classes.name: PushTestResult
classes.description: Result of a push notification test, including status and tokens.

classes.name: SecretsReloadParams
classes.description: Parameters for reloading secret commands.

classes.name: SecretsResolveParams
classes.description: Parameters for resolving secret command with target IDs.

classes.name: SecretsResolveAssignment
classes.description: Assignment for secret resolution with path segments and value.

classes.name: SecretsResolveResult
classes.description: Result detailing success, assignments, diagnostics, and inactive references.

classes.name: SessionsListParams
classes.description: Parameters for listing session metadata.

classes.name: SessionsPreviewParams
classes.description: Parameters for previewing session keys.

classes.name: SessionsResolveParams
classes.description: Parameters for resolving sessions based on various filters.

classes.name: SessionsCreateParams
classes.description: Parameters for creating a new session.

classes.name: SessionsSendParams
classes.description: Parameters for sending a message in a session.

classes.name: SessionsMessagesSubscribeParams
classes.description: Parameters to subscribe to session messages.

classes.name: SessionsMessagesUnsubscribeParams
classes.description: Parameters to unsubscribe from session messages.

classes.name: SessionsAbortParams
classes.description: Parameters to abort a session run.

classes.name: SessionsPatchParams
classes.description: Parameters to patch session metadata with various settings.

classes.name: SessionsResetParams
classes.description: Parameters for resetting a session with optional reason.

classes.name: SessionsDeleteParams
classes.description: Parameters for deleting a session and optionally its transcript.

classes.name: SessionsCompactParams
classes.description: Parameters for compacting session logs.

classes.name: SessionsUsageParams
classes.description: Parameters for generating session usage reports.

classes.name: ConfigGetParams
classes.description: Parameters for fetching configuration.

classes.name: ConfigSetParams
classes.description: Parameters for setting raw configuration with optional base hash.

classes.name: ConfigApplyParams
classes.description: Parameters for applying configuration with optional note and restart delay.

classes.name: ConfigPatchParams
classes.description: Parameters for patching config with note.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaParams
classes.description: Parameters for fetching config schema.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaLookupParams
classes.description: Parameters for looking up a schema by path.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaResponse
classes.description: Schema response including schema, UI hints, version, and timestamp.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaLookupResult
classes.description: Result of schema lookup with children and hints.

classes.name: WizardStartParams
classes.description: Parameters to start configuration wizard.

classes.name: WizardNextParams
classes.description: Parameters to advance wizard session with answers.

classes.name: WizardCancelParams
classes.description: Parameters to cancel wizard session.

classes.name: WizardStatusParams
classes.description: Parameters to check wizard session status.

classes.name: WizardStep
classes.description: Structure representing a wizard step, including type, message, options, etc.

classes.name: WizardNextResult
classes.description: Result after advancing a wizard session, including whether done, next step, and errors.

classes.name: WizardStartResult
classes.description: Initial result for starting a wizard session.

classes.name: WizardStatusResult
classes.description: Result containing current status of wizard session.

classes.name: TalkModeParams
classes.description: Parameters to enable or disable talk mode with phase info.

classes.name: TalkConfigParams
classes.description: Request parameters for retrieving the talk system configuration.

classes.name: TalkConfigResult
classes.description: Response with system configuration for talking.

classes.name: TalkSpeakParams
classes.description: Parameters for text-to-speech with voice, style, speed, and other options.

classes.name: TalkSpeakResult
classes.description: Result containing the generated audio in base64 and related info.

classes.name: ChannelsStatusParams
classes.description: Parameters for checking channel status, probe option, and timeout.

classes.name: ChannelsStatusResult
classes.description: Detailed status report for channels including labels, system images, and meta.

classes.name: ChannelsLogoutParams
classes.description: Parameters for logging out of a channel for a specific account.

classes.name: WebLoginStartParams
classes.description: Parameters to initiate web login flow.

classes.name: WebLoginWaitParams
classes.description: Parameters to wait for web login completion.

classes.name: AgentSummary
classes.description: Summary info for an agent, including id, name, identity, and model.

classes.name: AgentsCreateParams
classes.description: Parameters to create a new agent with name, workspace, emoji, and avatar.

classes.name: AgentsCreateResult
classes.description: Result of creating an agent including its ID and name.

classes.name: AgentsUpdateParams
classes.description: Parameters for updating agent info.

classes.name: AgentsUpdateResult
classes.description: Result after updating an agent.

classes.name: AgentsDeleteParams
classes.description: Parameters for deleting an agent.

classes.name: AgentsDeleteResult
classes.description: Result of deleting an agent, including number of bindings removed.

classes.name: AgentsFileEntry
classes.description: Information about a file associated with an agent.

classes.name: AgentsFilesListParams
classes.description: Parameters for listing agent files.

classes.name: AgentsFilesListResult
classes.description: Result listing files for an agent.

classes.name: AgentsFilesGetParams
classes.description: Parameters to get a specific agent file.

classes.name: AgentsFilesGetResult
classes.description: Result with file details.

classes.name: AgentsFilesSetParams
classes.description: Parameters to set contents of an agent file.

classes.name: AgentsFilesSetResult
classes.description: Result after setting a file.

classes.name: AgentsListParams
classes.description: Parameters for listing agents.

classes.name: AgentsListResult
classes.description: Result with list of agents and scope.

classes.name: ModelChoice
classes.description: Structure for selecting a model, including id, name, provider, and reasoning capability.
